user.description: Sign in with your State Grid online account (phone number and password). A one-time SMS device verification may be required.

device_verification.description: A 6-digit SMS code was sent to the phone ending in {phone_suffix}. Enter it to finish the new-device verification.

reauth_confirm.description:
Automatic re-login failed: {auth_error}
Click continue to retry with the saved password.

reauth_credentials.description: Enter the new State Grid password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the State Grid service ({error_message})
error.cannot_send_verification_code: Failed to send the SMS code ({error_message})
error.invalid_verification_code: The SMS code is wrong or expired ({error_message})
error.interactive_challenge_unsupported: The server security check failed ({error_code}). Retry later, or complete verification in the official app and change the password first.
error.local_error: Failed to build the request locally: {error_message}

abort.wrong_account: This account is configured under another entry; reauthenticate there.

data.compat_legacy_store: Write the legacy state_grid.config compatibility file (for state_grid_info and similar helpers)
